_doc: CI fails when a feature result is below a minimum (or above a max_*). Raise these as quality improves; never lower them to make CI green. Replay mode: 'pass' = recorded answers that survive the product pipeline AND pass every deterministic grader; 'negatives_caught' = injected faults caught by a product guard or a grader; 'guard_block_rate' = faults a PRODUCT guard must stop (not just the grader); 'blocked_good' = good answers wrongly blocked by a guard; 'privacy' / 'privacy_injected' (masked features only) = no raw phone / NID / account / e-mail in the provider request, as-is and with a private line injected (every value back on unmask). Rule features: 'must_pass' over cases without a listed known gap; 'max_known_gaps' can only go down.
